query:
SELECT cv.id, cv.ceoId, cv.tubeId, cv.viaNumber, cv.label, 
       cv.fusedToTubeId, cv.fusedToViaId, cv.fusedToSplitterId, cv.fusedToSplitterViaId,
       ct.identifier as tube_name,
       c.name as ceo_name
FROM ceo_vias cv
JOIN ceo_tubes ct ON ct.id = cv.tubeId
JOIN ceos c ON c.id = cv.ceoId
WHERE cv.fusedToTubeId IS NOT NULL OR cv.fusedToSplitterId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cv.ceoId, cv.tubeId, cv.viaNumber;
